ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45:55 ratio of high-intensity (white/light grey) to low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity central region extending from the peduncle. Large high-intensity contiguous regions on the distal lobes. Transition zones exhibit high-frequency low-intensity streaks and mottled patterns over light backgrounds.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Well-defined V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude serration pattern; includes a major irregular excision/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature profile along the distal portions of the trailing edge leading to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular and annular scars (over 25 distinct units) distributed across both lobes, appearing as white rings on dark pigment and dark rings on light pigment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark linear disruptions; notable series of long diagonal rake marks on the right lobe and smaller scattered horizontal abrasions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible clusters of high-relief, high-intensity barnacle organisms attached to both lateral tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of small, low-intensity speckles localized within the upper high-intensity patch on the left lobe.
